Who You Are Graduate in Commerce, Accounting, Finance or a related discipline. 5-9 years of experience in Order-to-Cash (O2C), Accounts Receivable, Order Management, Collections or Credit Control. Experience handling customer deductions, short payments, billing discrepancies and collection disputes. Working knowledge of SAP or other ERP systems. Good proficiency in MS Excel and reporting. Strong communication, coordination, analytical and problem-solving skills. Willing to work night shifts to support US and global business operations.

title: Manager, Indirect Tax Planning
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, youll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. Introduction To Team Our Corporate Functions are made up of teams that support Expedia Group, including our Global Finance Org., Traveler and Partner Service Platform, Legal Team, Strategy and Corporate Development Team, and People Places Org. Expedia Group is seeking a Manager, Indirect Tax Planning to join our Tax team in our Bangalore, India office under a hybrid working model. In this role you will provide indirect tax planning support across Expedia Groups many business entities and functions throughout the Asia Pacific (APAC) and global regions, advising on the indirect tax implications of new products, business models, market entries, and intercompany arrangements. You will partner closely with Tax colleagues across Seattle, Sao Paulo, London, and India as well as with Finance, Legal, Other Business stakeholders, and external advisors, to help ensure global business initiatives are structured in an indirect-tax-efficient and compliant manner. Expedia Group is a global traveler-technology company whose brands power travel for everyone, everywhere. Through our house of brands and broad partner network, we connect travelers with travel experiences around the world and develop technology solutions for a wide range of partners. The scale, diversity, and pace of change across our APAC markets create meaningful opportunities to shape indirect tax outcomes on high-impact, cross-border initiatives. This role is ideal for an experienced indirect tax professional who enjoys partnering directly with the business, translating complex GST/VAT and other indirect tax rules across APAC and other jurisdictions into practical guidance, and building scalable planning processes. You will bring deep expertise in global indirect tax regimes and play a key role in growing the indirect tax planning capability out of our Bangalore office, with clear room for continued career development. In this role, you will In partnership with your tax colleagues located in our core offices listed above, provide indirect tax planning advice on new business initiatives, products, and market entries across the many business entities and functions Expedia Group operates throughout the APAC and other regions. Serve as a trusted indirect tax planning resource for business and functional stakeholders across our global business, translating GST/VAT and other indirect tax requirements into clear, actionable guidance. Analyze the indirect tax implications of intercompany transactions, new entity structures, and evolving business models, and recommend planning approaches that balance tax efficiency, risk, and operational feasibility. Partner with the Indirect Tax Operations, Direct Tax, Transfer Pricing, Legal, and Finance teams to ensure planning positions are properly documented, implemented, and reflected in downstream compliance and reporting. Monitor and analyze existing and proposed indirect tax legislative and regulatory developments across APAC and other jurisdictions and proactively assess and communicate their impact on Expedia Groups business entities and functions. Support due diligence, restructuring, and business advisory projects involving APAC and other entities, including transactional tax data analysis, scenario modeling, and tax research. Use and help enhance tax technology tools (e.g., AI and agentic capabilities, Alteryx, Power BI/Tableau, Power Automate, SharePoint, ERP/Oracle) to improve the quality, consistency, and efficiency of indirect tax planning analysis and operational compliance processes. Help build and continuously improve indirect tax planning processes, templates, and controls to support a rapidly scaling business footprint. Work as an integral part of the broader tax team, contributing to cross-functional initiatives and supporting a culture of continuous improvement across the global tax function. Experience Qualification Bachelors or Graduate degree in Accounting, Finance, Law, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA, or equivalent professional certification preferred. Additional postgraduate qualifications in tax or accounting are a plus. 5-8 years of tax experience in a corporate tax department or public accounting firm, with a meaningful focus on indirect tax planning, operations, controversy and advisory work. Proven experience advising on GST/VAT and other indirect tax matters across multiple APAC jurisdictions (e.g., India, Singapore, Australia, Japan, or similar) and other geographies; experience with U.S. or other international indirect tax regimes like DST and withholding is also valued. Experience partnering directly with business and functional stakeholders to assess the indirect tax impact of new products, business models, or market entries. Experience supporting cross-border restructuring, intercompany arrangements, or new entity set-up from an indirect tax perspective. Experience with indirect tax project work, including business advisory, financial reporting considerations, and tax research. Demonstrated ability to act as a senior resource and informal leader for junior colleagues in a team setting, without formal people management responsibility. Experience with tax technology and automation tools including agentic and AI workflow development and use. Experience supporting indirect tax audits, controversy matters, or revenue authority inquiries across is a plus. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with experience managing large data sets; experience with Oracle or other ERP systems. Experience with indirect tax compliance/planning software and/or data analytics tools preferred. Experience leveraging AI, automation, or analytics tools to improve data analysis, documentation drafting, and process efficiency while maintaining appropriate review and controls. Ability to analyze, compare, evaluate, reconcile, and draw clear insights from complex indirect tax data across multiple jurisdictions. Excellent researcher and problem-solver who can analyze, compare, evaluate, reconcile, and learn from complex tax data to drive practical, accurate planning recommendations. Strong communicator who knows when and how to ask questions, raise issues, and provide meaningful updates to business stakeholders and senior leadership, effectively working across cultures and time zones. Natural collaborator and informal leader - approachable, engaged, and effective at creating a supportive day-to-day environment for junior colleagues without formal management authority. Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously while meeting strict deadlines in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. title: Commercial Finance Business Partner
description:
Commercial Finance Business Partner role. This is tailored for a finance team that supports reseller/channel businesses and acts as a strategic business partner to Sales, Vendor Management, Operations, and Commercial teams. Job Description Job Title Commercial Finance Business Partner Reseller Group Reports To Head of Commercial Finance / Finance Director Role Purpose The Commercial Finance Business Partner is responsible for providing financial leadership and decision support to the Reseller Group. The role partners with Sales, Vendor Management, Procurement, Operations, and Leadership teams to drive profitable growth, improve commercial performance, maximise vendor incentives, and support strategic decision-making. The individual will act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, providing financial insights, performance analysis, forecasting, and commercial challenge to optimise revenue, margin, working capital, and return on investment. Key Responsibilities Business Partnering & Commercial Support Partner with Reseller Business Leadership to drive profitable revenue growth. Provide financial insights and challenge business decisions to improve performance. Support sales teams in evaluating large deals, bid proposals, and commercial agreements. Assist business leaders in developing strategic business plans and growth initiatives. Influence commercial decision-making through robust financial analysis. Financial Planning & Forecasting Lead monthly forecasts and annual budgeting processes for the reseller business. Develop revenue, gross margin, operating profit and cash flow forecasts. Monitor business performance against plan and identify risks and opportunities. Support long-range planning and strategic investment decisions. Revenue & Margin Management Analyse revenue, gross profit and profitability across customers, vendors and product categories. Identify margin leakage and opportunities for improved commercial returns. Support pricing decisions and discount governance processes. Monitor deal profitability and post-deal performance. Vendor Program & Incentive Management Partner with Vendor Management teams to maximise vendor rebates, incentives, MDF and programme benefits. Ensure accurate forecasting and accounting of vendor income. Monitor achievement of vendor programme targets. Provide visibility of rebate opportunities and risks to business leadership. Commercial Analysis & Decision Support Prepare business cases for new products, partnerships, investments and acquisitions. Provide scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis. Evaluate customer, product and vendor profitability. Support strategic reviews and commercial negotiations. Performance Reporting Develop and maintain commercial performance dashboards. Present financial performance to senior leadership. Analyse key business drivers and recommend corrective actions. Deliver monthly business reviews highlighting trends, risks and opportunities. Working Capital & Cash Management Partner with operations and finance teams to optimise: Inventory Accounts Receivable Vendor Funding Cash Flow Monitor stock holding and inventory turns. Support initiatives to improve cash conversion cycles. Governance & Controls Ensure compliance with financial controls, policies and governance requirements. Support audit and compliance activities. Maintain accuracy and integrity of commercial financial reporting. Ensure proper recognition of revenue, margins and vendor income. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Revenue Growth Gross Margin % Operating Profit Vendor Rebate Achievement Forecast Accuracy Working Capital Improvement Inventory Turns Cash Conversion Cycle Business Case Realisation Return on Investment (ROI) Budget Adherence Qualifications Essential Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA), CIMA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent. Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce or Business. Preferred MBA Finance or equivalent postgraduate qualification. Experience in technology distribution, IT reseller, hardware/software, telecommunications or channel-based businesses. Experience 8 to 15 years of Finance experience. Strong Commercial Finance and Business Partnering background. Experience supporting Sales, Vendor Management or Commercial functions. Experience in: Revenue forecasting Margin analysis Pricing and profitability Business case development Financial modelling Vendor incentive programmes Key Skills Commercial Acumen Pricing Strategy Margin Management Contract Evaluation Deal Review & Approval Financial Expertise Financial Modelling Budgeting & Forecasting Scenario Planning Business Case Evaluation Analytics & Tools Advanced Excel Power BI (Advantage) ERP Systems ( SAP , Oracle, Dynamics) Financial Reporting Tools Business Partnering Stakeholder Management Executive Communication Influencing & Negotiation Strategic Thinking Leadership Behaviours Results-Oriented Data-Driven Decision Making Continuous Improvement Mindset Ability to Challenge Constructively High Integrity and Accountability Success Profile The successful candidate will be a commercially minded finance leader who can translate financial data into business actions, influence senior stakeholders, and drive sustainable profitable growth across the reseller business while maintaining strong financial governance and control. This version is suitable for a Senior Manager / Finance Business Partner level. For your role as a Finance Head, I would recommend positioning it as "Senior Commercial Finance Business Partner Reseller Group" with ownership of Revenue, GP, Vendor Rebates, Working Capital and Strategic Planning across the reseller P&L.

Key Skills: Reseller market,Commercial Finance,Finance Business Partner,Finance,Commercial,Business Finance

description:

 An order processing executive manages incoming customer purchases from entry to final 
 shipment. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Order Entry and Verification: Receive and input purchase details, prices, and customer 
 information accurately into the company's software. 
 Inventory Coordination: Check stock levels to confirm product availability before fulfilling 
 requests. 
 Shipping and Logistics: Work with the warehouse team to ensure goods are picked, packed, 
 and labeled correctly for on-time delivery. 
 Customer Support: Answer buyer questions regarding delivery times, tracking, and order 
 status. 
 Issue Resolution: Handle returns, order cancellations, and payment discrepancies quickly. 
 1.Receiving Inventory 
 Unload incoming goods from suppliers or manufacturers. 
 Inspect items for damage and verify quantities match the purchase order. 
 Log the items into the inventory management system. 
 2.Storing Inventory 
 Move goods to short- or long-term storage in the warehouse. 
 Organize products logicallyoften placing fast-moving items in easily accessible locations 
 Label products with barcodes or tags for fast tracking. 
 3.Processing Orders 
 Begin when a customer places an order online or in-store. 
 Verify payment confirmation and check real-time stock availability. 
 Generate a digital packing slip for the warehouse. 
 www.tecqnio.com 
 
 
 
 4. Picking 
 Workers or warehouse robots use the packing slip to locate items. 
 Retrieve the correct sizes, colors, and quantities from shelves. 
 Use barcode scanners to reduce human error. 
 5. Packing 
 Select appropriate boxes, mailers, and padding (like bubble wrap) to protect goods. 
 Keep package weight and size as low as possible to reduce shipping costs. 
 Seal the box and apply the shipping label. 
 6. Shipping 
 Hand off the packed boxes to a logistics carrier (like a postal service or freight line). 
 Provide tracking information to the customer. 
 Dispatch the shipment on a transport vehicle. 
 7. Processing Returns 
 Handle items sent back by customers due to size, defects, or preference. 
 Inspect returned goods to see if they can be restocked. 
 Issue refunds or exchanges and update inventory logs.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Senior Accountant Accounts & Finance 
 Position 
 Senior Accountant Accounts & Finance 
 Finance & Accounts 
 Department 
 Reporting To 
 Location 
 Director Finance & Accounts / CFO 
 Bangalore 
 Employment Type 
 Full-Time 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a Senior Accountant Accounts & Finance who will be responsible for managing day-to-day 
 accounting operations, statutory compliance, reconciliations, receivables/payables, month-end closing and financial 
 reporting. 
 The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in accounting and taxation, be detail-oriented, and be 
 capable of independently managing routine finance activities with minimal supervision. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Accounting & Bookkeeping 
 Maintain accurate and up-to-date books of accounts. 
 Record and verify sales, purchases, expenses, receipts, payments and journal entries. 
 ¢ Ensure proper accounting classification and supporting documentation for all transactions. 
 ¢ Maintain customer, vendor and general ledger accounts. 
 ¢ Perform regular ledger scrutiny and resolve accounting discrepancies. 
 ¢ Ensure timely posting of bank and other financial transactions. 
 2. Accounts Receivable & Payable 
 ¢ Monitor customer outstanding balances and prepare ageing reports. 
 ¢ Coordinate with sales/business teams for timely collection of receivables. 
 ¢ Track vendor payments and maintain payable ageing. 
 ¢ Perform customer and vendor ledger reconciliations. 
 ¢ Follow up on discrepancies, debit/credit notes and outstanding items. 
 3. Bank & Balance Sheet Reconciliation 
 ¢ Perform regular bank reconciliations. 
 ¢ Reconcile customer, vendor, GST, TDS and other balance sheet ledgers. 
 ¢ Identify and rectify unreconciled or incorrect transactions. 
 ¢ Support preparation and review of monthly balance sheet schedules. 
 4. GST & TDS Compliance 
 ¢ Prepare data and workings required for monthly/quarterly GST compliance. 
 ¢ Review purchase and sales data for GST accuracy. 
 ¢ Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase records and books of accounts. 
 ¢ Assist with GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and other GST-related filings. 
 ¢ Calculate and process TDS deductions. 
 
 
 ¢ Prepare TDS workings and support timely TDS returns and certificates. 
 ¢ Coordinate with external consultants/auditors wherever required. 
 5. Month-End & Year-End Closing 
 ¢ Assist in monthly closing of books of accounts. 
 ¢ Prepare provisions, accruals, prepaid expenses and other month-end adjustments. 
 ¢ Ensure timely completion of monthly accounting activities. 
 ¢ Prepare schedules and supporting documents for statutory and internal audits. 
 ¢ Assist in year-end closing and finalisation of accounts. 
 6. MIS & Financial Reporting 
 ¢ Prepare periodic MIS reports as required by management. 
 ¢ Prepare revenue, expense, receivables, payables and cash-flow related reports. 
 ¢ Provide accounting data and analysis to the Finance Head/CFO. 
 ¢ Support preparation of budgets, forecasts and variance reports where required. 
 7. Audit & Compliance Support 
 ¢ Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors and tax consultants. 
 ¢ Provide required schedules, ledgers, invoices and supporting documents. 
 ¢ Track audit queries and ensure timely closure. 
 ¢ Maintain proper documentation for statutory and regulatory requirements. 
 8. Internal Controls 
 ¢ Ensure adherence to company accounting policies and internal controls. 
 ¢ Verify invoices, approvals and supporting documents before accounting/payment processing. 
 ¢ Identify accounting or process gaps and bring them to the attention of the Finance Head. 
 ¢ Maintain proper records and documentation for financial transactions. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 ¢ Bachelor's degree in Commerce / Accounting / Finance (B.Com preferred). 
 ¢ 36 years of relevant experience in Accounts & Finance. 
 ¢ Strong knowledge of accounting principles and bookkeeping. 
 ¢ Good working knowledge of GST and TDS. 
 ¢ Experience with MS Excel and accounting/ERP software. 
 ¢ Good understanding of bank, customer and vendor reconciliations. 
 ¢ Ability to independently handle day-to-day accounting activities. 
 ¢ Strong attention to detail and accuracy. 
 ¢ Good communication and coordination skills. 
 ¢ Ability to meet statutory and monthly reporting deadlines. 
 Preferred Experience 
 ¢ Experience working in an SME/MSME environment. 
 ¢ Experience in handling complete accounting cycles. 
 ¢ Experience with GST reconciliation and TDS compliance. 
 ¢ Experience coordinating with external auditors, tax consultants and internal auditors. 
 ¢ Working knowledge of Tally / ERP / accounting software. 
 
 
 ¢ Good Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP and basic financial reporting. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 ¢ Timely and accurate accounting entries. 
 ¢ Timely completion of monthly book closure. 
 ¢ Accuracy of GST and TDS workings. 
 ¢ Timely bank, customer and vendor reconciliations. 
 ¢ Reduction in unreconciled/outstanding ledger items. 
 ¢ Accuracy and timeliness of MIS reports. 
 ¢ Timely support for audits and statutory compliance. 
 ¢ Effective monitoring and reporting of receivables and payables. 
 Candidate Profile 
 We are looking for a hands-on Senior Accountant who can take ownership of accounting activities, identify 
 discrepancies proactively and work closely with the Finance Head, management, auditors, consultants and internal 
 teams. 
 The candidate should be comfortable working in a growing organisation where responsibilities may span accounting, 
 taxation, compliance, reporting and finance operations.

Respond to internal and vendor inquiries regarding invoice and payment status in a timely, professional manner. title: Data Integration Engineer (Senior Associate)
description:
Job Summary Grant Thornton GTech s Data Analytics function is dedicated to designing and delivering robust global data platforms that enable business solutions and high-quality analytics. The Analytics Engineer is responsible for building curated, analytics-ready datasets and semantic models that bridge data engineering and analytics, enabling trusted reporting and self-service consumption within the organization s Data Lakehouse. This hands-on role focuses on transformation development (dbt), dimensional modeling, semantic-layer and BI delivery (Power BI), and data quality. Working closely with Business teams, Data Architects, Data Engineers, and Analysts, the Analytics Engineer turns business requirements into well-structured, governed, and performant data products that serve as a trusted foundation for analytics, reporting, and AI. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and semantic models that enable trusted reporting and self-service consumption. Develop and maintain modular, well-documented data transformations using dbt, following established engineering standards and reusable patterns. Build and optimize dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas, data marts) aligned with the Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layer separation). Develop semantic models, metric definitions, and certified datasets in Snowflake and Power BI to support consistent, governed analytics consumption. Translate business and reporting requirements into transformation logic and business rules in partnership with data analysts and stakeholders. Conduct data profiling, validation, and reconciliation using Snowflake SQL to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of analytics outputs. Perform data lineage and impact analysis across Snowflake, upstream sources, transformation layers, and reporting layers. Implement data quality checks, tests, and observability for analytics pipelines and datasets. Optimize Snowflake queries, models, and transformations for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Collaborate with data engineers, ETL/ELT developers, and QA, and support UAT to resolve data-related gaps through iterative testing and validation. Apply governance-by-design practices (access, classification/metadata, certified datasets), and mentor and guide more junior team members. Skills Proven experience with Machine Learning, predictive analytics, and natural language processing. Strong programming skills in SQL and Python for data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and analytics. Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is required, including, ability to construct optimize complex SQL queries, variant/JSON parsing, schema and stage understanding, performance analysis troubleshooting, dynamic tables/materialized views, dbt-on-Snowflake (Streams Tasks), and secure views/masking for certified datasets. Working experience in Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold data layers) including mapping data flows across layers. Strong hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining modular, tested data transformations (ELT/ETL development and maintenance). Hands-on experience building semantic models and reports in Power BI (metric definitions, certified datasets, and self-service enablement). Experience developing curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and reusable transformation patterns.

description:
Financial Analyst Description - Job Summary 
 - This role is responsible for conducting moderately complex financial analysis tailored to specific functions or business units, offering crucial analytics to drive key decision making. The role ensures adherence to reporting standards, collaborates with department heads on budgets and long-term plans, and produces regular and ad-hoc financial reports for stakeholders. The role also fosters a knowledge management culture, utilizing expertise to address diverse challenges within the framework of company policies and procedures. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 - Performs moderately complex financial analysis that is either transactional or analytical in nature, for specific functions or business units. . Lease accounting in compliance to ASC842 and US GAAP requirement . Perform month end activities, balance sheet reconciliation and Balance sheet reviews

 - Acquires a comprehensive understanding of the organizations financial processes and gains proficient knowledge of the companys operations and business.

IT Service Desk Analyst / Senior Analyst (Global Enterprise Support) Job Title: IT Service Desk Analyst / Senior IT Service Desk Analyst Department: End User Support (EUS / BCC) Location: Bangalore, India (Strictly 5 Days On-Site / Work from Office) Experience Range: 4- 9 Years Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent Work Shift: Rotational Shifts (Follow-the-Sun Global Support Model) 
 Role Overview We are seeking customer-focused, operationally driven IT Service Desk Analysts and Senior Analysts (4-9 years of experience) to join a leading global enterprise's End User Support organization in Bangalore. In this hands-on, operationally focused role, you will deliver high-quality technical support to enterprise IT users worldwide across hardware, operating systems, applications, and collaboration tools, ensuring stable, secure, and productive workplace technology experiences. Operating within a follow-the-sun global operational model, you will triage and resolve incidents, fulfill service requests, manage complex escalations, and collaborate closely with Desktop Side Support, Desktop Engineering, Infrastructure, Network, Security, and Application resolver teams across regions. Depending on your experience level, you will execute playbook-driven support tasks, drive advanced cross-domain troubleshooting, contribute to problem management/RCA, and mentor junior team members. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. End User Support & Service Desk Operations Provide day-to-day first-line and advanced technical support globally across the enterprise IT environment (hardware, operating systems, applications, and collaboration tools). Log, categorize, prioritize, triage, and resolve incidents and service requests in strict adherence to defined SLAs and operational standard operating procedures. Troubleshoot and resolve end-user issues across Windows endpoints, account unlocks, password resets, MFA guidance, Outlook/email sign-in profiles, printing/peripheral issues, standard "how-to" queries, and basic network connectivity checks (Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, proxy). Execute routine service desk activities including onboarding and offboarding administration (joiner/mover/leaver processes), mailbox and shared mailbox access, distribution list/group membership updates, Teams/channel access requests, standard software installations, and printer mappings. 
 2. Incident Management & Advanced Troubleshooting Perform structured incident triage using checklists, diagnostic scripts, logs, knowledge articles, and Digital Employee Experience (DEX) monitoring tools (Nexthink) to validate issues and confirm impact and urgency. Act as an escalation point for complex incidents, driving thorough technical investigation, coordination across resolver groups, and timely restoration of service. Escalate issues that require deeper technical investigation via standard escalation paths, ensuring each ticket includes a complete triage package (symptoms, business impact, attempted troubleshooting steps, diagnostic logs, and user communications). Collaborate seamlessly with Desktop Side Support, Desktop Engineering, Infrastructure, Network, Security, and Application teams to resolve cross-domain incidents. Maintain clear and timely communication with end users and stakeholders, setting realistic expectations, providing regular status updates, and confirming resolution prior to ticket closure. 
 3. Service Requests, Access & Device Support Fulfill standard and repeatable catalog service requests (software provisioning, access requests, VPN setup guidance, email configuration/profile rebuilds, standard device/peripheral setup) using documented playbooks and automation where available. Support user identity, Single Sign-On (SSO), and access governance tasks in strict alignment with enterprise security policies and required approvals. Provide operational support for collaboration and productivity tooling (Microsoft 365, MS Teams, Exchange/Outlook) and common workspace peripherals (docking stations, headsets, monitors, printers). Coordinate device lifecycle activities with local Desktop Side Support teams (imaging, hardware replacements, break/fix logistics), ensuring accurate asset and ticket records. 
 4. Problem Management, Knowledge & Change Enablement Identify recurring incidents, monitor trend patterns, and contribute to Problem Management by logging symptoms, reproduction steps, workarounds, and supporting Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations. Author, review, and maintain standardized knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, runbooks, and ticket resolution notes to improve first-contact resolution (FCR) and support repeatability. Support IT change implementation activities (operational validation, user communications, hypercare support) and ensure service desk readiness for new or modified services. Maintain meticulous ticket documentation, categorization, and reporting inputs to support service performance, auditability, and continuous operational improvement. 
 5. Operational Excellence, Queue Governance & Mentoring Manage assigned ticket workload and monitor overall queue health to meet SLAs, highlight backlog bottlenecks, and escalate systemic risks or service-impacting trends to leadership. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, including repeat contact reduction, self-service adoption, and standardizing repetitive support procedures. Participate in follow-the-sun rotational shifts and on-call operational support as required, ensuring smooth shift handovers and ticket updates. Provide operational guidance, technical coaching, and mentoring to junior analysts when needed (for senior-level profiles). 
 Technology Stack Platforms: ServiceNow (ITSM), Nexthink (DEX Solution), Moveworks (AI Chatbot) Operating Systems: Windows Desktop OS, Mobile OS (iOS / Android basic support) Productivity & Collaboration: Microsoft 365, MS Teams, Exchange / Outlook, SharePoint Endpoint & Access Tools: Remote Assistance Tools, Endpoint Management Platforms, Active Directory, SSO, MFA, VPN Solutions ITSM Processes: Incident Management, Service Request Fulfillment, Problem Management, Change Enablement Knowledge & Self-Service: Enterprise Knowledge Base, Self-Service Portals, Support Runbooks

 Note: Only candidates with experience in International Merchant Card Disputes and Chargebacks will be considered. 

 JOB DESCRIPTION FOR 2A: 
 Role Summary: Own end-to-end merchant dispute handling across Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover, including chargeback, representment, pre-arbitration, and arbitration. Maximize recovery, ensure rule compliance, and deliver a strong merchant experience under network SLAs. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 A. Dispute & Chargeback Lifecycle: Triage disputes (including retrievals/RFIs), validate reason codes, and decide action (accept/represent/pre-arb/arb). Prepare and file Compelling Evidence (CE) for representments within network/processor SLAs. Lead pre-arbitration negotiations; prepare arbitration submissions with accurate documentation and clear arguments. Track outcomes, escalate edge cases, reduce cycle times, and improve win/recovery rates. 
 B. Evidence & Documentation: Collect and package CE: transaction logs, AVS/CVV/3DS data, device/IP signals, delivery proof, customer communications, screenshots, T&Cs/cancellation policies, refund records, support transcripts. Maintain reason-code libraries and SOPs aligned to Visa Claims Resolution (VCR) and Mastercard Dispute Resolution (MDR); ensure documentation is audit-ready. 
 C. Merchant & Stakeholder Communication: Liaise with merchants, Customer Support, Risk, Finance, acquirers/processors, and external partners to gather data and resolve disputes promptly. Educate merchants on prevention (billing descriptors/testing, receipt design, refund policies, shipping/signature confirmation, post-purchase communications). 
 D. Compliance & Controls: Adhere to Visa/Mastercard/Amex/Discover rules and acquirer/processor guidelines; ensure evidence integrity and privacy compliance. Support monitoring programs (e.g., Visa VDMP/VFMP; Mastercard ECP) by supplying accurate dispute/fraud metrics. 
 E. Reporting & Continuous Improvement: Track KPIs: representment win rate, recovery dollars, TAT/cycle time, pre-arb avoidance, write-off reduction, dispute ratio health. Identify root causes and drive prevention playbooks (descriptor hygiene, friendly-fraud defenses, SCA/3DS optimization, logistics/signature policies). Contribute to automation/templates and quality reviews to enable First-Time-Right submissions. 
 Required Qualifications: 1 to 2 years in merchant disputes & chargebacks across Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover. Practical exposure to VCR/MDR workflows and phases (chargeback representment pre-arb arbitration). Experience drafting reason-code-specific narratives and assembling CE. Hands-on with VROL, Mastercom/Claims Manager, Amex/Discover portals; CRM/ticketing tools. Strong analytical and written skills; ability to interpret payment data/logs to build a defensible case. High ownership, urgency, and resilience under tight deadlines; willingness to work US hours onsite (no hybrid/remote). 
 Preferred Qualifications: Experience with acquirers/PSPs (e.g., Fiserv/First Data, Worldpay/FIS, TSYS, Adyen, Stripe) and tools like Ethoca/Verifi Order Insight. Knowledge of chargeback prevention best practices. Intermediate Excel/Sheets; basic SQL/BI a plus. Exposure to merchant education/training on prevention. Bachelors degree in Business/Finance/Accounting/Commerce. 
 JOB DESCRIPTION FOR 3A: 
 Role Summary: Serve as the domain expert for multi-brand dispute managementelevating win rates through evidence strategy, rule interpretation (VCR/MDR/Amex/Discover), and advanced escalationswhile coaching the floor and owning complex/high-value cases. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 A. Complex Case Leadership: Own high-value/complex disputes end-to-end; optimize representment narratives and CE per reason code. Lead pre-arbitration strategies and arbitration submissions with precise arguments and artefacts. 
 B. Rule Interpretation & Governance: Interpret network rule changes; update SOPs/playbooks and roll out training/calibrations. Partner with acquirers/processors on policy clarifications and case-level negotiations. 
 C. Quality & Enablement: Review/approve critical submissions to ensure First-Time-Right quality; reduce rework/defects. Coach Agents; certify new hires for production; drive template/snippet/evidence-checklist improvements. 
 D. Prevention & Analytics: Identify friendly-fraud patterns and systemic gaps; recommend prevention (descriptor hygiene, refund/return design, SCA/3DS). Collaborate with Analytics/Automation to scale insights and reduce manual workload. 
 Required Qualifications: Deep knowledge of VCR/MDR, Amex & Discover procedures; strong case-law style writing. Hands-on with VROL, Mastercom, Amex/Discover portals; CRM; intermediate Excel; SQL/BI preferred. Proven track record improving win rates and reducing pre-arb volumes.

 1. JOB SUMMARY 
We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accountant with 23 years of experience to manage the Company's day-to-day accounting operations, payroll processing, statutory compliance, taxation, reconciliations, financial documentation, and reporting activities.
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in Tally, payroll management, PF/ESI-related activities, GST, TDS, bank reconciliation, accounts payable/receivable, invoice processing, statutory filings, and general accounting operations .
The candidate should be capable of independently handling routine accounting activities while maintaining accuracy, confidentiality, proper documentation, and timely compliance with applicable statutory requirements.

 2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 A. Day-to-Day Accounting 
 Maintain accurate and up-to-date books of accounts. Record daily accounting transactions in Tally / accounting software . Handle purchase, sales, receipts, payments, journal entries, and contra entries. Maintain proper accounting ledgers and supporting documents. Prepare and maintain vouchers, invoices, debit notes, credit notes, and other accounting records. Verify accounting entries against supporting documents. Ensure proper classification and accounting of expenses and income. Maintain petty cash and cash-related transactions. Monitor outstanding receivables and payables. Follow up on pending accounting documentation and approvals. Assist in month-end and year-end closing activities. 
 3. PAYROLL MANAGEMENT 
 Manage the Company's monthly payroll processing activities. Collect and verify employee attendance, leave, salary revisions, deductions, incentives, and other payroll inputs. Prepare monthly salary calculations and payroll sheets. Calculate statutory deductions and other applicable deductions. Coordinate with HR regarding employee joining, exit, salary changes, leave, attendance, and payroll-related information. Process salary-related accounting entries. Maintain employee payroll records and salary-related documentation. Prepare payroll reconciliation and verify salary payouts. Ensure payroll is processed accurately and within the defined payroll schedule. Maintain confidentiality of employee salary and compensation information. Assist employees and HR with payroll-related queries. 
 4. PF / EPF COMPLIANCE 
 Handle monthly PF/EPF-related payroll activities . Calculate employee and employer PF contributions as applicable. Prepare and verify PF contribution details. Coordinate and complete monthly PF-related filing/payment activities within applicable timelines. Maintain PF challans, ECR-related records, contribution statements, and supporting documents. Coordinate employee PF/UAN-related requirements with HR and employees. Reconcile PF deductions with payroll and accounting records. Maintain proper statutory records for audit and compliance purposes. Monitor applicable changes in PF regulations and ensure compliance with Company procedures. 
 5. ESI & OTHER STATUTORY PAYROLL COMPLIANCE 
 Handle applicable ESI-related payroll activities and filings . Calculate statutory contributions wherever applicable. Maintain employee statutory records and supporting documents. Prepare and maintain statutory challans and payment records. Coordinate with HR for employee statutory information. Ensure statutory payroll deductions and payments are accurately recorded. Assist with other applicable labour/statutory compliance requirements. 
 6. GST ACTIVITIES 
 Handle day-to-day GST-related accounting activities. Verify GST applicability on purchase and sales transactions. Maintain GST-related records and supporting documentation. Verify GST invoices for proper tax details. Assist in preparation and filing of applicable GST returns . Reconcile purchase/input tax credit data with available GST records. Monitor input tax credit and identify discrepancies. Coordinate with vendors/customers regarding GST invoice discrepancies. Maintain GST challans, returns, reconciliation statements, and supporting records. Assist during GST audits, assessments, and departmental queries. Ensure GST-related accounting records are maintained accurately and systematically. 
 7. TDS & INCOME TAX-RELATED ACTIVITIES 
 Calculate applicable TDS deductions on payments. Maintain TDS-related accounting records. Prepare and assist with periodic TDS payments and filings. Verify TDS applicability on vendor, professional, contractual, rent, and other applicable payments. Maintain TDS challans and supporting documentation. Assist in preparation and reconciliation of TDS returns. Handle TDS certificates and related documentation. Reconcile TDS deducted with books of accounts and applicable records. Coordinate with vendors/employees regarding TDS-related queries. Assist auditors/consultants with TDS-related information and documentation. 
 8. TALLY / ACCOUNTING SOFTWARE 
 Maintain Company accounts using Tally / Tally Prime or other accounting software. Create and maintain ledgers, groups, vouchers, and accounting masters. Record sales, purchases, receipts, payments, journals, and contra transactions. Perform ledger scrutiny and identify incorrect or missing entries. Maintain GST and TDS configurations where applicable. Generate accounting reports and statements from Tally. Maintain accurate and organized accounting data. Perform regular backups and ensure proper accounting data management as per Company procedures. 
 9. BANKING & BANK RECONCILIATION 
 Record bank transactions accurately in the accounting system. Perform regular Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS) . Identify and resolve differences between bank statements and books. Track bank receipts, payments, transfers, charges, and other transactions. Assist in preparation of payment instructions and banking documentation. Maintain proper records of bank statements and supporting documents. Monitor outstanding and unidentified bank transactions. 
 10. ACCOUNTS PAYABLE 
 Process vendor invoices and verify supporting documents. Verify invoices against purchase orders/approvals wherever applicable. Record vendor bills accurately in the accounting system. Track vendor outstanding balances. Prepare vendor payment statements and payment schedules. Verify applicable TDS/GST deductions before processing payments. Reconcile vendor ledgers. Coordinate with vendors for invoice, payment, GST, and TDS-related discrepancies. 
 11. ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE 
 Record customer invoices and receipts. Maintain customer ledgers and outstanding balances. Monitor accounts receivable and overdue payments. Prepare outstanding receivable reports. Reconcile customer accounts. Coordinate with internal teams regarding pending invoices and collections. Follow up on discrepancies in customer accounts and payment records. 
 12. MONTH-END & YEAR-END CLOSING 
 Assist in monthly closing of books of accounts. Perform ledger scrutiny and reconciliation. Ensure all income and expense transactions are recorded. Identify pending entries, accruals, provisions, and adjustments. Prepare monthly accounting reports. Assist in preparation of financial statements and management reports. Support year-end closing and audit requirements. Coordinate with external auditors, consultants, and internal management as required. 
 13. MIS & MANAGEMENT REPORTING 
Prepare and maintain periodic reports such as:
 Monthly expense reports Revenue reports Accounts payable reports Accounts receivable reports Outstanding reports Bank reconciliation reports Payroll reports PF/ESI reports GST reports TDS reports Cash flow information Vendor payment reports Employee salary reports Other Finance & Accounts MIS reports required by management 
 14. AUDIT & COMPLIANCE SUPPORT 
 Coordinate with internal and external auditors. Provide accounting records and supporting documents required for audits. Maintain proper documentation for statutory compliance. Assist in resolving audit observations and accounting discrepancies. Prepare schedules, reconciliations, and supporting statements required by auditors. Ensure financial records are properly organized and readily available. Assist management and external consultants during statutory compliance activities. 
 15. DOCUMENTATION & RECORD MANAGEMENT 
 Maintain organized physical and digital accounting records. Maintain invoices, vouchers, receipts, challans, bank statements, tax records, payroll records, and statutory documents. Ensure proper filing and indexing of financial documents. Maintain confidentiality of financial and employee information. Ensure accounting records are available for internal review and audit. 
 16. INTERNAL CONTROL & ACCURACY 
 Ensure accounting transactions are supported by appropriate documentation. Identify duplicate, incorrect, or unusual transactions. Maintain proper approval and documentation processes. Monitor accounting discrepancies and initiate corrective action. Follow Company's financial policies and accounting procedures. Maintain high levels of accuracy and attention to detail. Protect confidential financial, employee, vendor, and business information. 
 17. ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTING RESPONSIBILITIES 
The Accountant may also be responsible for:
 Expense verification and accounting. Travel and reimbursement accounting. Petty cash management. Fixed asset records. Depreciation-related accounting. Advance payments and employee advances. Vendor reconciliation. Customer reconciliation. Inter-account transfers. Journal adjustments. Accrual and provision entries. Financial documentation. Supporting management with accounting analysis. Other Finance & Accounts activities assigned by the Management / CFO. 
 18. REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS 
 Mandatory Skills 
 Tally / Tally Prime MS Excel Payroll processing PF / EPF ESI knowledge GST TDS Bank Reconciliation Accounts Payable Accounts Receivable General Ledger Journal Entries Invoice Processing Statutory Compliance Financial Documentation MS Excel Skills 
The candidate should have working knowledge of:
 VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP SUMIF / SUMIFS COUNTIF / COUNTIFS IF formulas Pivot Tables Sorting and filtering Conditional formatting Data reconciliation Basic Excel reporting and MIS preparation 
 19. QUALIFICATION 
 Bachelor's degree in Commerce / Accounting / Finance / Business Administration or related field. B.Com / M.Com candidates are preferred. Candidates with relevant accounting certifications or practical taxation experience will be an advantage. 
 20. EXPERIENCE 
 23 years of relevant experience in accounting and finance operations. Practical experience in Tally, payroll, PF, GST, TDS, and statutory compliance is preferred. Experience working in an IT/SaaS/startup environment will be an added advantage. 
 21. KEY COMPETENCIES 
 Strong accounting fundamentals. Good numerical and analytical ability. High attention to detail. Strong reconciliation skills. Good knowledge of statutory compliance. Ability to manage multiple accounting activities simultaneously. Good communication and coordination skills. Strong documentation skills. Ability to meet statutory and payroll deadlines. Problem-solving ability. Integrity and confidentiality. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Strong ownership and accountability. 
 22. DESIRED WORKING APPROACH 
The candidate should:
 Take ownership of assigned accounting activities. Ensure payroll and statutory activities are completed within deadlines. Identify accounting discrepancies proactively. Maintain accurate and audit-ready records. Coordinate effectively with HR, management, vendors, employees, banks, auditors, and consultants. Stay updated with applicable statutory and taxation requirements. Maintain strict confidentiality of Company financial and employee information. 
 23. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) 
Performance may be evaluated based on:
 Accuracy of accounting entries. Timely completion of monthly payroll. Timely PF/ESI-related compliance activities. Timely GST and TDS compliance support. Accuracy of bank and ledger reconciliations. Accuracy of vendor and customer accounts. Timely preparation of MIS reports. Reduction of accounting discrepancies. Audit readiness and documentation quality. Timely completion of month-end closing. Accuracy and completeness of financial records. Compliance with Company accounting policies and procedures. 
 24. REPORTING STRUCTURE 
 Managing Director / CEO 

 CFO / Finance Head 

 Accountant 
The Accountant will work closely with HR, Management, Vendors, Customers, Banks, Auditors, Tax Consultants, and other internal departments for finance, payroll, taxation, and compliance-related activities.

 CANDIDATE PROFILE 
We are looking for a responsible, detail-oriented, and hands-on Accountant who can independently manage day-to-day accounting operations while supporting payroll, PF, GST, TDS, Tally, reconciliations, statutory compliance, audit requirements, and financial reporting .
The ideal candidate should not only have theoretical accounting knowledge but also demonstrate practical experience in handling end-to-end accounting activities and statutory compliance within defined timelines .

title: Payments Processing Analyst, NCT
description:
Job Summary 
 Job Title- Payments Processing Analyst, NCT Location- Bangalore, India 
 
 Role Description 
 The Payments Processing Operator is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of all types of payments including processing of physical cash/valuables, as well as the handling of cash related investigations. This includes the processing of time-critical, complex transactions on behalf of the Bank s internal and external clients, cash-related investigations involving enquiries from clients and internal stakeholders on cash payments before and after execution. It often involves time critical, potentially complex or in some cases regulated tasks including interaction with internal and external stakeholders. The Payments Processing Operator undertakes the complete and accurate capturing of payment transactions including physical cash/valuables transactions, ensuring that all payment-related information and relevant parties are processed according to established Service Level Agreement (SLAs) and industry guidelines. In addition, the Operator should ensure that procedures are properly executed to reduce processing risk and identify potential areas for process improvement whether internally within the Bank or for our clients. The Payments Processing Operator may also be in direct contact with clients in relation to payment processing offered by the Bank if this is agreed with respective front office functions. They may need to deal with the escalation and remediation of client complaints as well as managing relationships with the front office and other internal and external parties at an appropriate level. 
 
 Your key responsibilities 
 Process items adhering to procedures and cut-off times. Assist the team in the day to day operations. Liaise with the sending location in case of any clarification. Communicate to the team all process related clarifications received from the sending location. Collate data regarding process issues and communicate the same to the Manager. Carry out all the EOD functions as per checklists and maintain the relevant records. Ensure that all self-assessment reports and backup papers are signed by the responsible person after checking and the report is countersigned by the Team Manager. Carry out the monthly departmental self-assessments, based on the checklists. Ensure that the checking is done in true spirit and evidences all control lapses with suggested actions. 
 
 Additional Responsibilities

title: Finance Controller/Manager
description:
Role Overview We are looking for a Head of Finance / Finance Controller to take ownership of the finance function at Habanero Foods. This is a high-ownership role for someone who is comfortable operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and can independently manage the core finance function while partnering closely with the founder and the CFO. The role will cover accounting, financial reporting, MIS, AR/AP, inventory, cash flow forecasting, cash management, compliance, controls and commercial finance. The successful candidate will also have the opportunity to build and lead a finance team as the business scales. 
 Role & responsibilities : 1.Finance & Accounting Own day-to-day finance and accounting operations. Drive timely monthly book closure and ensure accuracy of accounting records. Prepare monthly P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow and management MIS. Ensure accurate accounting of revenue, expenses, inventory, receivables and payables. Improve accounting processes and finance systems. Coordinate with auditors, tax advisors and external stakeholders. 2. MIS & Business Reporting Own the monthly MIS and management reporting process. Prepare variance analysis against budgets, forecasts and prior periods. Develop business dashboards and management KPIs. Provide insights on revenue, gross margins, contribution margins, operating costs and profitability. Partner with the CFO and Founder on financial and business analysis. Develop reporting to enable faster and informed business decisions. 3. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management Own weekly and monthly cash flow forecasting. Maintain rolling cash flow forecasts and proactively identify funding requirements and cash gaps. Monitor collections, vendor payments, inventory and overall working capital. Drive improvements in the cash conversion cycle. Support cash management, banking and treasury activities. Partner with the Founder and CFO on working capital strategy and funding requirements. 4. Accounts Receivable & Payable Own the AR and AP function. Monitor customer collections and outstanding receivables. Reconcile customer accounts and resolve deductions, claims and disputes. Ensure timely and accurate vendor payments. Establish effective credit, collection and payment processes. Track ageing and working capital metrics and proactively escalate issues. 5. Quick Commerce & Marketplace Finance Own financial reconciliations across Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, Amazon, Flipkart and other platforms. Reconcile platform sales, settlements, commissions, discounts, claims, deductions, marketing spends and other charges. Identify and recover incorrect deductions, claims and short payments. Track platform-wise revenue, gross margin and contribution margin. Partner with sales and operations teams to improve channel profitability. Establish robust marketplace reconciliation and settlement tracking processes. Prior experience with quick-commerce or marketplace platforms will be an advantage. 6. Inventory & Cost Management Own inventory accounting and stock reconciliation. Monitor inventory levels, ageing, stock movement and holding periods. Analyse product-level gross margins and manufacturing costs. Track wastage, expiry, write-offs and inventory variances. Support costing and financial evaluation of new product launches. Partner with operations and supply chain teams to identify cost optimisation opportunities. 7. Budgeting & Financial Planning Support annual budgeting and business planning. Prepare rolling forecasts and periodic reforecasts. Build financial models for new products, channels and growth initiatives. Analyse profitability across products, channels and customers. Support decisions on pricing, promotions, marketing spends and channel expansion. 8. Compliance & Financial Controls Ensure timely compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax and other applicable statutory requirements. Coordinate statutory and tax audits. Strengthen internal financial controls and SOPs. Establish controls across procurement, inventory, sales, collections and payments. Drive automation and digitisation of finance processes. 9. Team Building & Finance Function Development Build and develop the finance team as the business scales. Define roles, responsibilities and processes within the finance function. Mentor and develop finance team members. Establish scalable finance processes and controls. Build a finance function that supports the companys transition from an entrepreneurial setup to a larger, professionally managed organisation Qualification CA preferred CMA / MBA (Finance) with strong relevant experience may also be considered. Strong accounting and finance fundamentals are essential. Experience 46 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts / Financial Controllership. Experience in D2C, FMCG, Food & Beverage, e-commerce, consumer brands or quick commerce strongly preferred. Experience managing a finance function independently will be an advantage. Experience with Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, Amazon, Flipkart or similar marketplace platforms is highly desirable. Strong experience in AR/AP, inventory accounting, working capital and cash flow management . Experience in a high-growth entrepreneurial environment preferred. Technical Skills Strong accounting and financial reporting knowledge. Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills. Experience with Zoho Books, Tally or similar ERP/accounting systems . Strong understanding of GST, TDS and statutory compliance. Experience in MIS preparation, budgeting and financial analysis. Strong understanding of inventory and cost accounting. title: Finance Officer
description:
Role Overview: The Finance Officer is responsible for managing Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, and Payroll operations while ensuring accurate and timely financial processing. The role ensures compliance with company policies and statutory regulations, supports month-end closing, tax reporting, and reconciliations, and maintains strong financial controls. The ideal candidate will have solid accounting knowledge, ERP proficiency, and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders. Job Structure: Mode of Work: Onsite (5 days a week) Work Location: Bangalore. Job Type: Fulltime Shift timings: 9-5 (M-F) Roles & Responsibilities. Accounts Payable: Manage and supervise all aspects of the payable accounts function at the station and for other regional countries if relevant, ensuring that the Company's books are updated on a daily basis and that payments are processed accurately and within guidelines laid down by company procedures. Ensure supplier contracts are valid and where they are nearing expiry, ensure that revised contracts are in place in good time. Take active measures to update contracts in the required systems. Proactively switch from paper invoices to EDI format with suppliers to streamline process. Perform rate verification in DMS diligently and timely. Ensure that suppliers without contracts are reviewed and approved by HO accordingly. Take the lead in ensuring that suppliers are paid on time and ideally by EFT. Review various AP reports to ensure that errors are corrected timely to facilitate a smoother month end process. Respond to supplier queries in an efficient manner. Accounts Receivable: Manage and supervisor all dedicated ongoing Finance receivable activities from business to ensure all receivables are correctly accounted for in a timely manner and in compliance with local regulations. Ensure receipts are processed timely for the entire region and allocated accurately to customer invoices. Ensure receipts are banked within specified time limits or as per agreement with cash collection provider. Reconcile BSP/ credit card party accounts and highlight short settlements immediately to line manager. Review bank reconciliations daily and account for transactions in AR/ GL module as appropriate immediately. Closely monitor under-collections and work efficiently with Commercial to ensure action is taken timely. Ensure outstanding debt from credit parties is collected timely as per Group Policy. General Ledger: Process journals in accurately in timely manner so that monthly timetable is met. Prepare data in order to conduct reconciliations for appropriate nominals. Prepare standard reports for monthly file which is reviewed by Internal Audit and OF&RM Finance Review Team. Prepare reports for local tax filing. Prepare data for monthly KPI submission. Prepare bank reconciliations for review. Assist with repatriation process to ensure that surplus funds are remitted to HO and working capital is maintained as per Group Policy. Assist Financial Controller where necessary in ad hoc projects. Payroll: To compile and process all payroll elements including basic salaries, allowances, overtime, shift pay, pension contributions, employer and employee social security contributions and relevant taxation in compliance with local regulations to all staff on payroll within required time limits. Ensure the relevant payments are submitted to local authorities in a timely manner and all payments are in line with individual terms and conditions of employment. Compile and provide all payroll information, including the reconciliation of tax and social security and pension on a monthly basis and send payments to the appropriate parties so that this can be computed in accordance within the specified time frame. Prepare payroll data entry into Finance software so that all relevant reports are completed in a timely manner. Seek clarification with external legal advisors on taxation, payroll or any other upcoming issues to ensure that all year end returns are submitted on a timely basis. Scrutinise all staff expenses, process salary advances, medical expenses and any other staff loans to ensure correct payment or recovery of same through payroll; and reconcile the related ledger account. Maintain and reconcile Petty Cash account where appropriate, and analyse and reimburse Petty Cash returns from other stations from within the country as appropriate. Ensure charges from personal telephone calls are recovered from staff on a monthly basis and mobile telephone bills are paid in line with the company guidelines. Reconcile the pension account and assist with various pension and other queries from staff, department heads and various external parties. Assist FAM and undertake various administrative duties together with other relevant finance personnel as necessary. Qualifications: MCOM/MBA in Finance / BCOM or degree in related field of study Experience: Min 6 to 8 years of professional experience, of which 2 years must be in a supervisory capacity. Knowledge/skills: Knowledge of rules and procedures under the local laws to take care of statutory requirements as necessary. Ability to function independently within an established framework and to be practical and innovative. Proven experience in both supervising a finance function and in coaching and developing staff as well as experience in working in a large multinational and dealing with stakeholders from different countries. Proven ability to organize a busy work schedule, working under pressure and ensuring adherence to deadlines. Knowledge of local payroll, taxation, statutory and compliance requirements. Proficient in the use of MS Office, in particular spreadsheets and ERP systems.

description:
Position: Chartered Accountant Controllership, MIS & Financial Planning
 Department: Finance & Accounts
 Reporting To: Finance Controller / CFO
 Location: Bangalore 
 Role Overview We are seeking a qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) to manage controllership activities, financial reporting, MIS preparation, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning. The candidate will play a key role in driving financial discipline, management reporting, business analysis, and supporting strategic decision-making through accurate financial insights. 
 Key Responsibilities Preparation and finalization of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements. Preparation and review of Management Information System (MIS) reports for senior management. Preparation of budgets, rolling forecasts, and long-term financial projections. Variance analysis between actuals, budgets, and forecasts with actionable insights. Monitoring financial performance and key business KPIs. Support business planning and strategic financial decision-making. Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards including Ind AS. Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors, and tax consultants. Review general ledger balances, reconciliations, and financial controls. Preparation of cash flow forecasts and working capital analysis. Support in consolidation of financial statements and group reporting. Develop and improve reporting automation and financial dashboards. Ensure accuracy and integrity of financial data within ERP systems. Assist management in cost optimization and profitability analysis. Support during board meetings and preparation of financial presentations. 
 Required Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and Ind AS. Excellent analytical and financial modeling skills. Hands-on experience in MIS reporting and financial planning & analysis (FP&A). Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or D365. Ability to prepare business forecasts and management presentations. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Attention to detail and ability to meet strict deadlines. Good understanding of budgeting, cash flows, and business performance analysis. 
 Educational Qualification Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA). Experience 03 years of relevant experience in controllership, MIS reporting, financial planning, forecasting, and financial statement preparation. Preferred Industry Exposure Real Estate, Infrastructure, Manufacturing or any large corporate environment. Key Deliverables Timely and accurate financial reporting. High-quality MIS and management presentations. Reliable budgeting and forecasting models. Improved financial controls and reporting efficiency. Actionable financial insights for business growth.

Job Description: Finance Executive AP & AR Role Overview We are looking for a Finance Executive to manage day-to-day Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) activities, ensure timely accounting and collections, and maintain accurate financial records. The role requires strong attention to detail, good coordination with customers and vendors, and the ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines. Key Responsibilities Accounts Payable (AP) Process and verify vendor invoices, purchase orders, and supporting documents. Ensure invoices are accurately recorded and approved before payment processing. Maintain vendor accounts and reconcile vendor statements. Track outstanding payables and prepare payment schedules. Coordinate with internal teams and vendors to resolve invoice discrepancies. Ensure timely processing of vendor payments. Maintain proper documentation for all AP transactions. Accounts Receivable (AR) Raise and issue customer invoices based on agreed contracts, milestones, and billing schedules. Track customer outstanding balances and maintain accurate AR records. Follow up with customers for overdue payments and payment confirmations. Prepare and share customer statements and ageing reports. Reconcile customer accounts and resolve billing/payment discrepancies. Coordinate with sales, project, and customer support teams on billing-related matters. Maintain regular collection follow-ups and provide updates on overdue accounts. Reconciliation & Reporting Perform regular bank, customer, and vendor reconciliations. Prepare AP/AR ageing reports and outstanding reports. Monitor overdue receivables and escalate long-pending balances. Support month-end and year-end closing activities. Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation. Assist in audit requirements and provide necessary financial data. Additional Responsibilities Ensure compliance with internal finance processes and controls. Maintain confidentiality of financial and customer information. Support management with finance-related reports and analysis. Identify process gaps and suggest improvements to improve billing, collections, and payment processes. Maintain clear communication with internal stakeholders, customers, and vendors. Required Skills Strong knowledge of Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes. Good understanding of basic accounting principles. Experience with invoice processing, billing, collections, reconciliations, and ageing. Good knowledge of MS Excel, including basic formulas and reporting. Experience working with accounting/ERP software. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills. High attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities. Experience 2–5 years of experience in Finance, Accounts, AP/AR, or a similar role. Key Performance Indicators Timely and accurate invoice processing. Reduction in overdue receivables. Timely customer collections and payment follow-ups. Accurate vendor and customer reconciliations. Timely AP payment processing. Accuracy of financial records and reports. Compliance with internal finance processes.

In this role you will be primarily responsible for End-to-End Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting and Internal Audit and Process Improvements and automation Process as SME or team focused on the complete, accurate, and timely completion of Fixed Assets & Reporting and related activities within the General Accounting (GA) team. Ensure compliance with internal guidelines and procedures as well as external regulatory requirements with strong understanding of USGAP and FA Module. Fixed Asset Accounting Operations Manage end-to-end fixed asset accounting processes. Ensure accurate capitalization, transfers, retirements, disposals, and depreciation of assets. Review and approve asset creation requests in compliance with accounting policies. Maintain the fixed asset register and ensure completeness and accuracy. Monitor Construction-in-Progress (CIP) accounting and capitalization activities. Financial Reporting & Month-End Close Execute month-end, quarter-end, and year-end fixed asset close activities. Review depreciation runs and accounting entries. Prepare and validate fixed asset reconciliations between subledger and general ledger. Support financial statement disclosures related to Property, Plant & Equipment (PP&E). Analyze asset balances and investigate significant movements. Identify control gaps and implement corrective actions. Support internal and external audits through timely preparation of schedules and explanations. Asset Lifecycle Management Govern the complete asset lifecycle from acquisition to disposal. Ensure appropriate asset classification and useful life assignment. Review impairment assessments and asset write-offs. Monitor leased assets and right-of-use assets where applicable. Reconciliation & Data Quality Perform periodic asset register reviews and reconciliations. Resolve discrepancies between procurement, project accounting, and fixed assets records. Ensure asset master data accuracy and integrity. Develop and track key performance metrics related to fixed asset processes. Reporting & Analytics Prepare management reports on capital expenditures, depreciation, asset additions, and disposals. Support budgeting and forecasting activities related to fixed assets. Provide insights into capital investment trends and asset utilization. Develop dashboards and report solutions for stakeholders. Stakeholder Management Act as the primary point of contact for fixed asset-related queries. Partner with Finance, Procurement, Tax, Controllership, and Business Operations teams. Coordinate with external auditors, statutory auditors, and tax advisors. Provide guidance on fixed asset accounting treatments and policy interpretations. Process Improvement & Automation Identify and drive process improvement initiatives. Lead standardization and harmonization of fixed asset processes across entities. Support system implementations, upgrades, and testing activities (e.g., SAP, Oracle, S4-HANA,Trintech) Promote automation opportunities to improve efficiency and control. SME Governance Responsibilities Serve as the functional expert for fixed asset accounting. Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Deliver training and knowledge-sharing sessions to team members. Provide guidance during transitions, migrations, and transformation projects. Review complex accounting transactions and determine appropriate treatment. Key Skills & Competencies: Strong knowledge of Fixed Assets Accounting, PP&E, Depreciation, Capitalization, and Asset Retirement. Experience with IFRS, US GAAP, and internal controls. ERP knowledge (SAP, Oracle,). Advanced Excel and reporting skills. Analytical problem-solving and stakeholder management. Audit support and compliance expertise. A master’s degree in accounting, Finance or Commerce (MBA/Mcom) is must. Minimum 10to 12 years of experience in Fixed Assets Accounting and Record to Report GA. Job Description: Finance Executive AP & AR Role Overview We are looking for a Finance Executive to manage day-to-day Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) activities, ensure timely accounting and collections, and maintain accurate financial records. The role requires strong attention to detail, good coordination with customers and vendors, and the ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines. Key Responsibilities Accounts Payable (AP) Process and verify vendor invoices, purchase orders, and supporting documents. Ensure invoices are accurately recorded and approved before payment processing. Maintain vendor accounts and reconcile vendor statements. Track outstanding payables and prepare payment schedules. Coordinate with internal teams and vendors to resolve invoice discrepancies. Ensure timely processing of vendor payments. Maintain proper documentation for all AP transactions. Accounts Receivable (AR) Raise and issue customer invoices based on agreed contracts, milestones, and billing schedules. Track customer outstanding balances and maintain accurate AR records. Follow up with customers for overdue payments and payment confirmations. Prepare and share customer statements and ageing reports. Reconcile customer accounts and resolve billing/payment discrepancies. Coordinate with sales, project, and customer support teams on billing-related matters. Maintain regular collection follow-ups and provide updates on overdue accounts. Reconciliation & Reporting Perform regular bank, customer, and vendor reconciliations. Prepare AP/AR ageing reports and outstanding reports. Monitor overdue receivables and escalate long-pending balances. Support month-end and year-end closing activities. Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation. Assist in audit requirements and provide necessary financial data. Additional Responsibilities Ensure compliance with internal finance processes and controls. Maintain confidentiality of financial and customer information. Support management with finance-related reports and analysis. Identify process gaps and suggest improvements to improve billing, collections, and payment processes. Maintain clear communication with internal stakeholders, customers, and vendors. Required Skills Strong knowledge of Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes. Good understanding of basic accounting principles. Experience with invoice processing, billing, collections, reconciliations, and ageing. Good knowledge of MS Excel, including basic formulas and reporting. Experience working with accounting/ERP software. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills. High attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities. Experience 2–5 years of experience in Finance, Accounts, AP/AR, or a similar role. Key Performance Indicators Timely and accurate invoice processing. Reduction in overdue receivables. Timely customer collections and payment follow-ups. Accurate vendor and customer reconciliations. Timely AP payment processing. Accuracy of financial records and reports. Compliance with internal finance processes.
