title: SME-Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting.
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This Position reports to: Accounting & Reporting Manager - General Accounting
  SME-Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting. Take your next career step at ABB with a global team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. At ABB, we have the clear goal of driving diversity and inclusion across all dimensions: gender, LGBTQ+, abilities, ethnicity and generations. Together, we are embarking on a journey where each one of us, individually and collectively, welcomes and celebrates individual differences. You will be working as SME-Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting and will be reporting to Accounting & Reporting Manager – GA and will be a part of Bangalore, India. In this role you will be primarily responsible for End-to-End Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting and Internal Audit and Process Improvements and automation Process as SME or team focused on the complete, accurate, and timely completion of Fixed Assets & Reporting and related activities within the General Accounting (GA) team. Ensure compliance with internal guidelines and procedures as well as external regulatory requirements with strong understanding of USGAP and FA Module. Fixed Asset Accounting Operations Manage end-to-end fixed asset accounting processes. Ensure accurate capitalization, transfers, retirements, disposals, and depreciation of assets. Review and approve asset creation requests in compliance with accounting policies. Maintain the fixed asset register and ensure completeness and accuracy. Monitor Construction-in-Progress (CIP) accounting and capitalization activities. Financial Reporting & Month-End Close Execute month-end, quarter-end, and year-end fixed asset close activities. Review depreciation runs and accounting entries. Prepare and validate fixed asset reconciliations between subledger and general ledger. Support financial statement disclosures related to Property, Plant & Equipment (PP&E). Analyze asset balances and investigate significant movements. Compliance & Internal Controls Ensure compliance with IFRS, US GAAP, local statutory requirements, and company accounting policies. Maintain SOX/internal control documentation and evidence. Identify control gaps and implement corrective actions. Support internal and external audits through timely preparation of schedules and explanations. Asset Lifecycle Management Govern the complete asset lifecycle from acquisition to disposal. Ensure appropriate asset classification and useful life assignment. Review impairment assessments and asset write-offs. Monitor leased assets and right-of-use assets where applicable. Reconciliation & Data Quality Perform periodic asset register reviews and reconciliations. Resolve discrepancies between procurement, project accounting, and fixed assets records. Ensure asset master data accuracy and integrity. Develop and track key performance metrics related to fixed asset processes. Reporting & Analytics Prepare management reports on capital expenditures, depreciation, asset additions, and disposals. Support budgeting and forecasting activities related to fixed assets. Provide insights into capital investment trends and asset utilization. Develop dashboards and report solutions for stakeholders. Stakeholder Management Act as the primary point of contact for fixed asset-related queries. Partner with Finance, Procurement, Tax, Controllership, and Business Operations teams. Coordinate with external auditors, statutory auditors, and tax advisors. Provide guidance on fixed asset accounting treatments and policy interpretations. Process Improvement & Automation Identify and drive process improvement initiatives. Lead standardization and harmonization of fixed asset processes across entities. Support system implementations, upgrades, and testing activities (e.g., SAP, Oracle, S4-HANA,Trintech) Promote automation opportunities to improve efficiency and control. SME Governance Responsibilities Serve as the functional expert for fixed asset accounting. Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Deliver training and knowledge-sharing sessions to team members. Provide guidance during transitions, migrations, and transformation projects. Review complex accounting transactions and determine appropriate treatment. Key Skills & Competencies: Strong knowledge of Fixed Assets Accounting, PP&E, Depreciation, Capitalization, and Asset Retirement. Experience with IFRS, US GAAP, and internal controls. ERP knowledge (SAP, Oracle,). Advanced Excel and reporting skills. Analytical problem-solving and stakeholder management. Audit support and compliance expertise. A master’s degree in accounting, Finance or Commerce (MBA/Mcom) is must. Minimum 10to 12 years of experience in Fixed Assets Accounting and Record to Report GA. Experience leading teams in a shared service, GBS, or multinational environment. Strong knowledge of working in SAP & FA Module. description:
Position: Senior Analyst Supply Solutions | Fashion
 Contract: 6 Months
 Experience: 46 Years
 Location: Bengaluru, India
 Key Skills: Supply Chain, PO Management, Supplier Performance, Supply Solutions, Advanced Excel, SQL, Power BI/Tableau 
 Senior Analyst Supply Solutions | Fashion Function: Supply Solutions
 Location: Bengaluru, India
 Job Level: Individual Contributor – Senior Analyst Role Purpose The Senior Analyst – Supply Solutions is responsible for delivering accurate and timely purchase order execution while elevating the function from transactional processing to AI-enabled, data-driven decision support. The role combines operational discipline, strong analytical judgment, and practical program management to improve service levels, reduce delays, and solve supplier-facing execution risks at scale. What Success Looks Like Order cycles run on time with high transaction quality and clear exception ownership. Teams receive proactive, insight-led recommendations rather than passive status reporting. Supplier delay risks are identified early, triaged correctly, and resolved through structured action plans. AI and automation improve speed, consistency, and quality of operational decisions. Cross-functional governance is reliable, transparent, and outcome-focused. Key Responsibilities 1. Operational Execution and Control Execute weekly ordering for replenishment and non-replenishment purchase orders with strong data accuracy. Manage the PO lifecycle, including revisions, status tracking, exception logging, and issue closure. Coordinate supply chain interruption updates, including factory constraints, shipment slippages, and recovery plans. Publish concise progress updates for business stakeholders with clear decisions, actions, and ownership. Maintain SOPs and control documents with disciplined versioning and audit readiness. 2. AI and Advanced Analytics – Mandatory Analyze demand, forecast, and order signals to detect outliers, risk clusters, and recurring root causes. Use AI-assisted tools responsibly for anomaly detection, prioritization logic, and insight generation. Develop practical analytical frameworks to separate urgent exceptions from low-impact noise. Convert complex analysis into simple business narratives for planners, merchants, and leadership teams. Build scalable KPI views and dashboards that improve action speed and accountability. Measure and communicate the impact of AI and automation using baseline-versus-outcome metrics. 3. Supply Solutions – Mandatory Lead structured problem-solving for supplier delay scenarios, from detection to closure. Run cross-functional action plans with sourcing, planning, logistics, and supplier partners to recover at-risk orders. Define and track delay recovery playbooks, including alternatives such as re-prioritization, partial allocation, and timeline resets. Create and maintain early-warning indicators for supplier performance and delivery risk. Drive weekly risk reviews with clear escalations, dependency management, and decision logs. Recommend systemic fixes that reduce repeat delay patterns and improve planning reliability. 4. Collaboration and Capability Building Partner with product and technology teams to design, test, and deploy process improvements. Coach team members on structured analytics, data interpretation, and exception triage methods. Ensure compliance with Walmart policies, data quality standards, and responsible AI usage principles. Added Advantage: Apparel and Fashion Domain Knowledge Understanding of apparel and fashion supply chain dynamics, including seasonality, lead-time sensitivity, and style-level variability. Awareness of fashion lifecycle constraints such as launch windows, trend-driven demand shifts, and markdown risk. Ability to interpret supplier and capacity constraints in the context of apparel and fashion planning cycles. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related discipline. 4–6 years of relevant experience in order management, supply chain, retail, CPG, or a similar environment. Advanced Excel and strong working knowledge of SQL for analysis, validation, and insight generation. Demonstrated analytical strength in framing hypotheses, identifying root causes, and driving actions. Strong stakeholder communication and program-tracking skills in cross-functional environments. Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent. Experience applying AI-enabled methods in operations, planning, or analytics. Experience in supplier performance programs and delay recovery governance. Role Expectation This is not a transaction-only role. The Senior Analyst is expected to combine flawless execution with analytical depth, program management rigor, and practical AI adoption to improve business outcomes.

Guided by our core values of integrity, innovation and customer satisfaction, we continue to redefine industry standards and exceed expectations. About the Role: 
 We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Finance Controller to lead the finance and accounts function of the organization. The ideal candidate will be a Chartered Accountant with a strong background in financial control, compliance, and reporting preferably with exposure to the gold loan, bullion, NBFC, or financial services industry. This role requires a strategic thinker who can ensure financial discipline, regulatory compliance, and support 
 business growth through sound financial governance. Key Responsibilities: Financial Control & Reporting: Oversee preparation of accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial 
 statements in line with applicable accounting standards (Ind AS/IGAAP). Ensure robust internal financial controls (IFC) are designed, implemented, and monitored across the organization. Manage the monthly closing process, including reconciliations, accruals, and variance 
 analysis. Present financial performance reports, MIS, and dashboards to senior management and the board. Compliance & Regulatory: Ensure compliance with statutory requirements Income Tax, GST, TDS, RBI/NBFC 
 regulations (if applicable), Companies Act, and other applicable laws. Liaise with statutory auditors, internal auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities. Ensure timely filing of returns, audits, and regulatory submissions. Stay updated on changes in gold loan/bullion trade regulations, RBI guidelines, and 
 financial compliance norms. Treasury & Cash Flow Management: Monitor daily cash flow, fund positions, and working capital requirements Manage banking relationships, credit facilities, and gold-backed lending/borrowing 
 arrangements. Oversee gold inventory valuation, hedging strategies, and price risk management (if 
 applicable to bullion operations). Budgeting & Financial Planning: Lead the annual budgeting process and periodic forecasting/re-forecasting. Conduct cost analysis and identify areas for cost optimization and margin improvement. Support business heads with financial insights for strategic decision-making. Audit & Risk Management: Coordinate statutory, internal, and tax audits; ensure timely closure of audit observations. Identify financial risks and implement mitigation controls. Ensure adequate documentation and audit trails for all financial transactions. Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and manage the finance and accounts team. Set performance goals, review team output, and build finance function capability. Coordinate cross-functionally with operations, compliance, HR, and business teams. Required Qualifications & Experience: Chartered Accountant (CA) mandatory. Minimum 8+ years of post-qualification experience in finance/accounts, with at least 3 
 years in a leadership/controllership role. Prior experience in gold loan companies, NBFCs, bullion trading, jewellery, or 
 financial services industry strongly preferred. Strong knowledge of Ind AS/IGAAP, Income Tax, GST, and RBI/NBFC regulatory 
 framework. Hands-on experience with ERP/accounting systems (Tally, SAP, Oracle, or similar) and 
 MS Excel. Proven experience managing statutory and internal audits. Key Skills: Strong analytical and financial acumen Excellent knowledge of regulatory and statutory compliance Strong leadership and people management skills High attention to detail and accuracy Strong communication and stakeholder management skills Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities Integrity and sound ethical judgment (critical given handling of high-value gold assets) What We Offer: Competitive compensation aligned with industry standards Leadership role with direct exposure to senior management/board Opportunity to shape financial governance in a growing organization
